meta.title: dkitchen
meta.description: A kitchen of DeepSeek Harness sessions: stations, tickets, long jobs, and the bell that wakes them.

setupNote: The tools are registered inside this harness process, so installing the bundle is the whole installation. Nothing else to run.
setupStatus: Each repository supplies its own stations, routes, and ticket settings through that file. Call the dkitchen_status tool to see what one repository resolved, including which directory the answer came from.
agentMessage: The dsh-dkitchen bundle is installed and its tools are registered in this harness process, so there is nothing else to install or run. A repository configures its kitchen with a .dkitchen.toml at its root: [kitchen] stations, [models.<station>] routes, [status] and [sessions] vocabulary, and an optional [approval] section naming tools that may be answered without asking the user. When the user asks what the kitchen will do, call dkitchen_status to report the resolved stations, routes, and approval policy, and say which directory it resolved from.
